utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and point people to the sign-up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. If you get the time, place, and what they still need, send it my way and I’ll help share it too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’ll get the time, place, and remaining needs to you as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with the biggest safety issues first, and I can map out the spots that need attention. We can kick off at a simple start time once we’ve got the list sorted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Gus — I’ll mark the spots that need the most urgent attention and set a simple start time. Once the list’s ready, we can head to the community center on Maple Street for drop-off too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot — once you have the timing and a rough list, I can see what I can realistically take on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll send over the timing and list right now, and you can grab whatever you’re able to.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — send it over and I’ll check what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m still spreading the word, and I’ll make sure folks know about the repair drive. If you’ve got any new details, send them my way and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep spreading the word and let neighbors know the plan. If anything changes, send it my way and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll keep telling folks nearby, and if you get any updates, send them over so I can share them too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, that’d be a real help, Tess—just let me know what’s still needed and I’ll pass it along. I’m likely to forget it again, but I’ll do my best!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet—I’ll poke around and see what’s still on the list. Then I’ll swing back and let you know right quick.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Much obliged, Tess. I’ll keep my ears open, and if anything comes to me before then, I’ll let you know right off.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it’s still steady for now—just keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’m around if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—please map the safety spots and give me a clear start time, and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll map the safety spots and set a clear start time for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, thank you. Once you have the safety spots and start time, I’ll be there and follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — is there a specific time for the drop-off, and do they want the items labeled?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure on the exact time yet, sorry — I’d check with Oren when you can. And yes, labeling them would probably help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll check with Oren for the exact time, and I’ll label the items in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Bo — the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still happening today—send me the list and I’ll grab what I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Keep it simple and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll check the tool table now and tell you what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Let me know the missing pieces and I’ll handle what I can quietly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — first I’m lining up the time, place, and a simple list of repair needs. Once that’s set, I’ll send the details around to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, Rosa — I’ll ask around and bring you the timing as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — that’s a big help. Once you have the timing, send it my way and I’ll keep everything organized from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with the biggest safety issues first, then the smaller fixes after that. I can map out the spots and give you a simple start time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds like a great plan — send me the spots and start time, and I’ll help get folks pointed to the sign-up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll put together the spots and a simple start time, then share it with you so folks can sign up where they’re needed most.

utterances.text: Noah: I’m still a bit behind on the repair drive details — what time and place are we meeting, and what items do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane — that works. I’ll wait for your update on the tool table and meeting details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it—sounds like it’s steady for now. Let me know if there’s anything I should help with.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira. If you can send the timing, location, and a rough hauling list, I can check what I’m able to take on.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll send over the timing, location, and hauling list as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I’d appreciate any help spreading the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. I’ll let folks nearby know and encourage them to come by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — that really helps. I appreciate you spreading the word and encouraging folks to come by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and let you know what’s still missing. If I hear anything useful, I’ll pass it along right quick.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. Just send me whatever you find, and I’ll round up the rest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet—I’ll ask around and send along whatever I hear. If folks mention anything urgent, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll send over the list and keep spreading the word about the repair drive so folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. Send the list when you can, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Just send me the simplest task, and I’ll fit it in if I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Much obliged, Uli — I’ll do my best to send you one of the simple fixes, like a loose hinge or a dripping faucet. I’m a touch forgetful, so I may need to double-check the list first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds fine, Oren. Just send the simplest one when you’ve checked the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got it — I’ll bring a hammer, a screwdriver, and a couple rolls of duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, that covers it. I’ll bring the batteries and a few more screwdrivers just in case.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll see you there and we can start sorting the tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still only hearing bits, but it sounds like the repair drive is moving along. If there’s an easy job or a list of what’s needed, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds about right — I can probably handle one of the easy fixes. Just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great — I’m still just catching up, so a list would help me know what’s actually needed. If there’s anything simple, I’m happy to pitch in too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — do you know what time the drop-off is, and if they still need anything specific packed or labeled?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m not sure on the drop-off time, but I’d like the place and a clear list of what to pack or label. If you know that, I can come prepared.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I only know it’s the community center on Maple Street, and they’re collecting repair supplies and small household fixes. If you get the time or any packing notes, please send them along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s still happening today. Thanks again for checking in; we can still use help with the tables and sorting the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s definitely the repair drive today, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, definitely today — we’re still on for the repair drive. Thanks for double-checking; we could still use help with the tables and the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — could you check the tool table for anything missing and tell me what needs to be lined up first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the tool table and line up the missing basics first. Then I’ll send you the list so you can grab whatever you can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — that’s perfect. Send me the list as soon as you have it, and I’ll line up the rest.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
